model: TUDOR Black Bay GMT M79830RB-0001 (41 mm steel, black dial, blue/red GMT bezel, steel bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Black Bay GMT template (config/watches/tudor-bbgmt-*): case, 24 h bezel (polished flange + blue/red insert + coin edge), crown on a neck and four hands (hour, minute, seconds, red GMT with arrow head) from the 41 mm photo silhouette; the black dial, indices, print, date window and minute track come from one 2x photo map with the photographed hands left in it.

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (straight diagonal lug flanks from the bezel to the bracelet); top slopes toward the strap

bezel.note: steel ring: polished flange (bezel_in, 1.475 mm wide, sloping up to the insert) + blue/red insert (to insert_out) + coin-edge ring (to bezel_out); colours, numerals and triangle come from the projected photo

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, 0.04 mm wider than the photographed hands so the 3D hands hide the ones in the map; the last point sits at the traced length. lume = +w side outline [s, w], mirrored about the axis. hands.polygons = free polygons in mm (GMT arrow head: red frame outline, white lume inset). Hands and hub use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: no crown guards; fluted part x 736..777 px, neck from the bezel to x 736 (84 px high); the photo shows about 80 fine flutes, 56 teeth keep the polygon count down (the flutes come from the projected photo)

strap.note: strap.kind selects the section built from strap[kind]; only the bracelet is used here

bracelet.note: Flat bracelet of three brushed columns (outer / centre / outer). Joints read from the photo with brightness scans, top and bottom separately (photo px, mm = distance from the pivot / 13.561): outer columns top joint y 162, bottom joint y 1063.5; centre column top joints 297 / 241 / 234 (a 0.5 mm dark band between 241 and 234), bottom 927 / 989 / 995 / 1101 / 1106; vertical joint lines x 381 / 515 (top), 380 / 514 (bottom). Rivet ears at the sides come from the alpha silhouette.

rubber.note: PLACEHOLDER for M79000N-0002 (not built here): one continuous column over the silhouette; list transverse grooves / end pieces per side in pieces_mm.strap, measure the y ranges (mm from the pivot) on the -0002 photo

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
